title: [LinuxBSD] shell_open silently drops URL on machines missing xdg-open (regression from #114521)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: `master` @ `a8643700ce` (4.7-dev) and every build since #114521 was merged (2026-01 or later).
- Not reproducible in: builds prior to #114521 — the old `execute()`-based path returned the child exit code synchronously, so `ERR_CANT_CREATE` from `execvp` was visible to the fallback chain.

This is a **regression** introduced by the fix for #114213 in #114521.

### System information

LinuxBSD, any desktop environment / container where `xdg-open` is absent but at least one of `gio`, `gvfs-open`, `kde-open5`, `kde-open`, or `exo-open` is present. Verified on:

- Minimal Xfce container (only `exo-open` installed)
- KDE Plasma container (only `kde-open5` installed)
- Flatpak runtime missing `xdg-open`

### Issue description

After #114521, `OS_LinuxBSD::shell_open` switched from `execute()` to `create_process()` to stop the UI from freezing (correct fix for #114213). As a side effect, the handler-fallback chain in `shell_open` became dead code.

Root cause: `OS_Unix::create_process` (`drivers/unix/os_unix.cpp:955-997`) returns `OK` as soon as `fork()` succeeds. `execvp` failures happen in the child and cause the child to `raise(SIGKILL)` itself; the parent never learns. So:

```cpp
// platform/linuxbsd/os_linuxbsd.cpp:545-581
Error ok = create_process("xdg-open", args);
if (ok == OK) { return OK; }  // always taken when fork() succeeds
// gio / gvfs-open / kde-open5 / kde-open / exo-open — never reached
```

On a machine that lacks `xdg-open` but has another handler, `OS.shell_open("https://example.com")` returns `OK`, the editor's UI thread keeps running (good — #114213 stays fixed), and the URL is silently dropped (bad — the user sees nothing open).

### Steps to reproduce

1. On a Linux machine (or container) with one URL handler installed but **not** `xdg-open`. Easiest setup:
   ```
   docker run --rm -it ubuntu:24.04 bash
   apt-get update && apt-get install -y kde-cli-tools   # provides kde-open5
   # do NOT install xdg-utils
   ```
2. Launch the Godot editor inside that environment (or attach an existing LinuxBSD editor binary).
3. From the editor, trigger any `shell_open` path — "Show in File Manager", "Online Documentation", "Report a Bug", etc.
4. Observed: editor UI does not freeze (good); but no browser/file-manager opens, and the status bar shows nothing. `OS.shell_open(...)` returns `OK`.
5. Expected: the first *available* handler is invoked; in this case `kde-open5` opens the URL.

Confirm via `strace -f -e execve` on the editor process:

```
[child] execve("/usr/bin/xdg-open", …) = -1 ENOENT
[child] write(2, "Could not create child process: xdg-open\n", …)
[child] SIGKILL
[parent] returns OK from create_process()
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A — reproducible from any empty Godot 4.7-dev project on a LinuxBSD machine missing `xdg-open`. Just `OS.shell_open("https://godotengine.org")` from a script attached to the main scene.

### Proposed fix

Open as #118671 — adds a `_binary_in_path` helper that walks `$PATH` with `access(..., X_OK)` before each `create_process` call in `shell_open`, so missing handlers are skipped instead of being treated as silent successes. Preserves the async behaviour from #114521; does not reintroduce #114213.
